summary: A trustee has to explain why a damaged library has neither a repair date nor a rebuilding date.
realLife: Boston's library president told trustees that the South End flood had disabled the building systems and that delayed supplies complicated the city's choice between repair and renovation.
inGame: needs: damage assessment and decision still pending.

turns.pulledBy: Replacement parts can be obtained before major construction.
turns.what: Facilities staff price a repair that could restore service sooner.
turns.writesBack: The next report compares cost with the months of use gained.

turns.pulledBy: Parts would arrive after the proposed work starts.
turns.what: Staff withdraw the interim repair estimate.
turns.writesBack: Trustees ask for the service plan covering the longer closure.
